findings.failure_path: A configuration with models.r={model="house-model",provider="p"} and providers.p={type="kimi",base_url="https://gateway.invalid/v1"} passes the subset check and returns family kimi. Nothing constrains that endpoint to Moonshot. If the gateway serves the implementer's family, the runner nevertheless admits it as an independent reviewer. This newly accepts configurations whose actual model family remains unknown.
findings.smallest_fix: Remove the provider-type fallback and skip unknown model ids. Add a regression covering type=kimi with an unknown model and custom endpoint.

findings.failure_path: JSON decoding errors are silently ignored. A clean-exit stream containing an earlier assistant 'No findings.' followed by a malformed or truncated final assistant finding returns the earlier clean answer. The gate can therefore pass malformed output, contrary to the repository contract. The new fixtures do not exercise this path.
findings.smallest_fix: Make a nonempty malformed JSON record invalidate the attempt, and add a regression with malformed final output following a clean-looking assistant message.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet provides review narratives and synthetic fixtures, but no current-candidate results for make test, the required shared-skill heavy/sanitization checks, or the claimed RED/GREEN mutation runs. It also supplies no successful real Kimi stream demonstrating the newly selected protocol. The required validation and compatibility checks cannot be established from this bounded evidence.
findings.smallest_fix: Attach candidate-bound command results, skips and RED/GREEN evidence, plus a redacted real Kimi stream fixture validating the parser's assumed message shape.

challenge_focus: Delta pass on the fixes made after the challenge. Findings they fix: (1) model_family('openai/house-model') returned codex from the provider alias; (2) a Kimi inline [models] table was not read structurally, so an alias selecting a Claude model counted as Kimi; (3) the Kimi config was read twice, so eligibility and launch could see different models; (4) live: Kimi text output carried narration before 'No findings.' so a clean answer never parsed; (5) live: Kimi top-level base_url/api_key and dotted providers/models assignments were dropped; (6) replay: an intent cut mid-character crashed the runner. Check the fixes and whether they open a new P0/P1.
